description: This file defines the 'Mean' class with static methods implementing various statistical mean calculations such as geometric mean, harmonic mean, and trimmed mean, as part of the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Mean
classes.description: A class providing static methods for calculating different types of means (geometric, harmonic, trimmed) used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: geometric
methods.description: Calculates the geometric mean of a set of positive numbers, returning an error if invalid data is provided.

methods.name: harmonic
methods.description: Calculates the harmonic mean of a data set, managing errors for non-positive values.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Calculates the mean of a data set after trimming a specified percentage of the top and bottom data points.
